harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed inventory-worker as a real OpenRC-managed service on node1 (Alpine/OpenRC). It runs as a dedicated unprivileged 'inventory' user inside a private mount namespace with a read-only overlay of the entire root filesystem (bind-remounted ro to avoid the ext4 EBUSY superblock-writer issue), with only /var/lib/inventory re-exposed writable via a bind mount, plus --no-new-privs. Verified writes elsewhere fail (Read-only file system) while /var/lib/inventory writes succeed, CapEff=0, NoNewPrivs=1. Completed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, issued a background-acked reboot, polled until the node returned, confirmed a new boot_id, and verified the service auto-started, the worker log persisted, and all confinement properties (ro root, no-new-privs, unprivileged uid/gid) held after restart.
actions_performed: Created system group/user 'inventory' with home /var/lib/inventory and nologin shell
Created /var/lib/inventory (mode 700, owned by inventory:inventory)
Installed /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh (long-running loop appending timestamps to /var/lib/inventory/worker.log)

Installed /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker-wrapper.sh implementing sandbox: tmpfs-backed rw overlay of /, bind+remount read-only, bind-mount real /var/lib/inventory back in as the sole writable path, then chroot + setpriv --no-new-privs drop to unprivileged user
Installed OpenRC service /etc/init.d/inventory-worker using unshare --mount --propagation private to run the wrapper, enabled via rc-update add inventory-worker default, started via rc-service
Verified confinement: writes outside /var/lib/inventory fail with 'Read-only file system'; writes inside succeed and persist; CapEff=0, NoNewPrivs=1, unprivileged uid/gid
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, service status, process, mountinfo, log contents)
Rebooted node1 via backgrounded 'reboot' so the exec call acknowledged before disconnect
Polled node1 until reachable again, confirmed changed boot_id
Verified post-restart: service auto-started at boot, worker process running, log persisted and still growing, sandbox confinement flags intact

evidence.requirement: inventory-worker deployed as a managed OpenRC service, enabled at boot, running as a long-lived background worker
evidence.summary: OpenRC service file installed, rc-update add to default runlevel, rc-service status shows 'started', worker process actively looping

evidence.requirement: Confined so it writes only inside /var/lib/inventory
evidence.summary: Read-only overlay bind-mount test: touch outside /var/lib/inventory fails with 'Read-only file system' while writes inside /var/lib/inventory succeed; worker process mountinfo confirms root mount 'ro,relatime'
Worker process /proc/PID/status shows NoNewPrivs:1 and CapEff:0000000000000000, running as unprivileged uid/gid 103/104 (inventory), both before and after restart

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 7b162ed4-..., service status started, process alive, worker.log actively appending, confinement flags verified pre-restart

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: restart acknowledged and returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'reboot' command acknowledged immediately; subsequent poll showed connection reset/timeout confirming the node went down

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: changed boot identity proven
evidence.summary: boot_id changed from 7b162ed4-9200-450c-8f8a-ffc93f6c378e to 18690a58-ace5-4ec4-a306-9090e7ba48ce, proving an actual reboot occurred, not just downtime

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: post-restart recovery of service, data, and confinement
evidence.summary: After reboot: service auto-started (rc-update default runlevel), worker process running under new PID, worker.log persisted with pre-restart entries and continued appending new entries, confinement flags (ro root, CapEff 0, NoNewPrivs 1, unprivileged uid/gid) all intact
